What gets in the way today

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Complex collateral structures

Asset cover is hard to judge when several lenders hold charges over different asset classes.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Money moving to group companies

Borrowers move funds to sister companies through unsecured loans or related-party advances.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Higher default exposure

Higher-yield lending needs closer watching after the money goes out.
